items.title: Apple reveals new AI architecture built around Google Gemini models
items.author: unclefuzzy
items.summary: Apple announced a new AI architecture based on Google's Gemini models. This update is part of Apple's Apple Intelligence platform. The collaboration aims to enhance AI capabilities across Apple devices.

items.title: Siri AI
items.author: 0xedb
items.summary: Siri AI is Apple's advanced voice assistant, now using Google's Gemini for improved capabilities. It's available for developers and users in beta, enhancing tasks and conversations.

items.title: xAI is looking more like a datacentre REIT than a frontier lab
items.author: martinald
items.summary: xAI has shifted focus to renting out its data center capacity, resembling a REIT more than a frontier AI lab. Its partnerships generate significant revenue, suggesting it's not pioneering cutting-edge AI. This business model prioritizes financial returns over research innovation.

items.title: Apple Core AI Framework
items.author: hmokiguess
items.summary: Core AI is Apple's new framework succeeding Core ML, introduced in 2026, to integrate third-party AI models into apps. It emphasizes on-device AI capabilities and offers advanced features like text summarization. Core AI enhances app intelligence with minimal code.

items.title: Hermes Agent – Open-source AI agent with persistent memory
items.author: SeriousM
items.summary: Hermes Agent is an open-source AI framework with persistent memory, developed by Nous Research. It runs on your server, learns from interactions, and enhances its capabilities over time. Released in February 2026, it integrates various skills and operates across platforms.

items.title: FrontierCode
items.author: streamer45
items.summary: Frontier Airlines does not have a permanent "50% off code." They offer limited-time discount codes and flash sales that vary by route and travel dates. Current promo codes offer up to 90% off base fares.

items.title: Ask HN: What are tools you have made for yourself since the advent of AI?
items.author: aryamaan
items.summary: I've created tools like a photo and video extractor, a pre-AI image search, and a comic display app. These help me manage my digital content and streamline my daily tasks.

items.title: I'm building a parallel internet, and it's called The Thinnernet
items.author: initramfs
items.summary: The Thinnernet is a proposed parallel internet aiming for lightweight, optimized web pages under 100KB. It's designed to offer a simpler, less cluttered online experience. The concept is gaining attention for its potential to redefine internet usage.

items.title: Confidential submission of draft S-1 to the SEC
items.author: hackerBanana
items.summary: Anthropic submitted a confidential draft S-1 to the SEC. The SEC allows confidential submissions for draft registration statements to protect issuers' stock prices and public awareness. This submission process is available for various types of offerings and transactions.

items.title: AI is slowing down
items.author: crescit_eundo
items.summary: AI progress is hindered by thermodynamic and infrastructure constraints, but the global market continues to grow rapidly. Key challenges include power supply limitations and data quality issues. Despite these, AI adoption remains strong.

items.title: Apple bets cheaper AI will woo small developers
items.author: jbernardo95
items.summary: Apple is opening its AI models to developers to encourage new app creation. This move aims to leverage its platform for cross-device AI development. The initiative is expected to boost innovation among small developers.

items.title: 1worldflag: A blue dot on a transparent background
items.author: davidbarker
items.summary: The One World Flag features a blue dot representing Earth on a transparent background, symbolizing unity and the idea that more unites humanity than divides it. Designed by Thomas Mandl in 2016, it aims to highlight global unity without replacing other national flags.

items.title: OCaml Onboarding: Introduction to the Dune build system
items.author: andrewstetsenko
items.summary: Dune is a build system for OCaml projects, used to compile libraries, executables, and tests. It uses a `dune` file for project structure and build specifications. This system helps manage dependencies and project organization efficiently.

items.title: Switzerland wil have a referendum to cap population at 10M
items.author: napolux
items.summary: Switzerland will hold a referendum on June 10 to decide on a far-right proposal to cap the population at 10 million. If passed, it would restrict newcomers and could lead to exiting EU agreements. The proposal is opposed by the government and business community.

items.title: Show HN: Command Center, the AI coding env for people who care about quality
items.author: Darmani
items.text:
Hi HN! We’re Jimmy and Ray. Jimmy is a Thiel Fellow with a Ph. D. from MIT who has worked on programming tools for 15 years; Ray became VP of Sales at a $2B company when he was 19 and has built side-businesses vibe-coding.

items.summary: Command Center is an AI coding environment that enhances code quality and speeds up code review and refactoring. It uses AI to provide automatic walkthroughs and integrates with other coding tools. It aims to help teams ship faster with high-quality code.

items.title: Replies to comments on my "LLMs are eroding my career" post
items.author: omblivion
items.summary: Replies to your post about LLMs eroding your career have sparked debate on job security in tech. Some agree, others suggest adapting. Focus on continuous learning.
